defs.def: to look at every part of sth carefully, especially because you are looking for a particular thing or person 细看；察看；审视；端详
to look quickly but not very carefully at a document, etc. 粗略地读；浏览；翻阅
to get an image of an object, a part of sb's body, etc. on a computer by passing X-rays, ultrasound waves or electromagnetic waves over it in a special machine （X 射线、超声波、电磁波等）扫描

ex.s: The cashier had scanned all the items and there were a couple of people ____13____ (wait) behind us.
ex.t: 收银员已经扫完所有商品，后面还有几个人____13____（等待）。
指纹扫描技术发展迅速。

ex.s: It tingles in the spine of all who hear wolves by night, or who scan their tracks by day.
ex.t: 它在夜里听到狼声的人的脊椎里 或在白天扫描他们的踪迹的人身上

ex.s: It only takes a blink of the eye – just scan the barcode and click!
ex.t: 它只需要眨一眨眼睛 - 只是扫描条码并点击!

defs.def: to pass across an area 光束、雷达等
to examine a computer program or document in order to look for a virus 程序
to pass light over a picture or document using a scanner in order to copy it and put it in the memory of a computer （用扫描设备）扫描（图像或文件）
to have a regular rhythm according to fixed rules 诗歌
a medical test in which a machine produces a picture of the inside of a person's body on a computer screen after taking X-rays 扫描检查
a medical test for pregnant women in which a machine uses ultrasound to produce a picture of a baby inside its mother's body 胎儿扫描检查
the act of looking quickly through sth written or printed, usually in order to find sth 浏览；快速查阅
